events.summary: Formal whistleblower/public-interest preservation notice to LinkedIn Ireland.
Case 241020-015316 restored after identity verification; LinkedIn described temporary restriction following detected suspicious activity.
Case 241028-011722 restored after identity verification; LinkedIn again described detected suspicious activity.

Security alert: profile photo changed at 13:51 GMT via Android; provider-reported approximate location Kuwait City, Kuwait. Account holder states that he made the profile-photo change himself and reports VPN use.
events.attribution: edit self-attributed by account holder; provider session/IP/risk context not established; approximate location may be VPN-related but is not provider-confirmed as such

events.summary: Gil Marer reports that LinkedIn account access was blocked again; renewed identity verification was completed; restoration/provider explanation remains pending.

Three 2021-2022 Sun Park management requests were documented and rejected; closed-state records followed; Google support confirmed reinstatement on 26 August 2022; later closure/change notices were preserved.
events.attribution: closure-state cause and any causal link to rejected requests remain open

events.summary: sbu001 account-level 403; Trust & Safety reference #1297 and Support Portal #753341 opened; connected workspace operational again by 23 September.
events.attribution: Support described repeated-login temporary lock as a possible mechanism; observed 403 persisted beyond expected interval; no external actor or retaliatory cause established

events.summary: User-facing browser/account access path reported blocked while authenticated integration, repository API and GitHub Pages remained operational.
events.attribution: cause, scope and duration of user-facing block not established

events.summary: Appeal case 260923-029467 remains open; LinkedIn Customer Support states that the member follow-up was forwarded to another group for additional review/advice and may require additional research.
events.attribution: process state confirmed; trigger, external reporting and causation not established

events.summary: Existing appeal/support and privacy/preservation threads were supplemented with UK-business relationship context, litigation-preservation requirements, source/trigger questions and a post-restoration paid-customer intention; no duplicate support case was created.
events.attribution: outbound request only; no external actor or causal attribution

events.summary: LinkedIn changed case 260923-029467 to Waiting For Information and requested a fresh Persona government-ID verification followed by a reply to the existing case. The account holder states that the new Persona flow was completed and a same-thread completion notice was sent.
events.attribution: provider request documented; user completion reported and outbound notice verified; provider receipt, restoration, trigger and external cause not established

events.summary: After completing the fresh Persona flow, the account holder replied in the existing appeal case seeking urgent interim restoration or the least restrictive temporary security measure while review continues, and supplied a controlled four-PDF evidence package. Transmission is verified; provider review, Persona acceptance, restoration and trigger classification remain pending.

A one-decision Article 21 DSA filing package was prepared for User Rights concerning the LinkedIn account restriction, framed as a moderation/account-enforcement dispute rather than hacking or account compromise. Live external form acceptance/submission remains outstanding; no User Rights receipt exists.

Counsel for RPL 3304/2025 was instructed to assess a narrowly framed supervening-evidence/preservation step concerning the LinkedIn restriction and provider-native evidence. No court filing or judicial receipt is claimed.
